name: Alexis Adrián
bio:
Born in Mexico City, Alexis Adrián, also known briefly as Gonzbreaker, is a content creator, director, photographer, and actor.

He has directed and appeared in several short films, and his role as Marcus Kelevra is his first leading role in a feature film.

credits.title: Nicolás de Jesús' Now You See Me...
credits.overview: Struggling fair owner Kesselring (Nicolás de Jesús) is given a unique opportunity to restore the fair to its former glory when his friend Dr. Goodkat (Fredy Roque) introduces him to Marcus Kelevra (Alexis Adrián), a man whose mysterious act will draw people back to the fair, at a deadly cost, and even sparking interest
